summary: Phases 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 are all COMPLETED and committed. Phase 3 remains PARTIAL (soft blocker, pre-existing, out of scope per standing user direction -- see blockers[0]). This dispatch resolved Phase 7's two ancestorTimes blockers and completed Phase 8's close-out: (1) Branch.lean's and SignedFormula.lean's ancestorTimes undirected-traversal bug (dropped directSuccessors, keeping only directPredecessors) unblocked the dedup gate past depth 1, flipping Gp -> F^k p to CLOSED for all k=1..5. (2) Rules.lean's allPastPosAt reused the future-only TimeOrdering.ancestorTimes in the wrong direction for past-obligation propagation; team lead confirmed Rules.lean was in-scope (task file_scope) and authorized the fix -- swapped the arguments so allPastPosAt checks whether t_anc is in t's future light-cone (equivalently t is in t_anc's past), which flipped the last remaining red row, Hp -> HHp. All 43 individually-executed conformance rows are now green (0 red). Phase 8 then: promoted Finding 2b/2c to a first-class DELIVERABLE 7 in task 552's state.json description; stripped forward-looking 'flips in Phase N'/commit-hash scaffolding from CslibTests/TableauConformance.lean, converting it into a pure regression guard justified purely by each formula's mathematical validity; confirmed the full corpus green in a single lake test run; confirmed the D1 validity-class note was already present in the harness header (Phase 1) and documented that no fuel-headroom table exists to record, since Phase 7's dedup strategy override never introduced a new fuel bound. Whole-project lake build (3253/3253) and lake test (9247/9247) both green throughout; Cslib/ bare-sorry count unchanged at 5; axiom count unchanged at 26 (0 new). Every fix was re-verified via a full CslibTests.TableauConformance build against pre-fix guard_msgs: each fix produced exactly the expected mismatches (12 rows for the ancestorTimes fix, 1 row for the allPastPosAt fix) and zero others, confirming zero regressions at every step.

blockers.description: IBranchSaturation's sat_timp field (and truthLemma's pre-existing T-imp sorry) cannot be discharged without a new step-lt-style fuel-sufficiency measure for applyPersistenceFixpoint's own recursion (Scheme.lean, 'sat_timp discharge STOP-gate' comment block). Phase 2's branching-rule redesign resolved the determinacy half (Gap 2); the fuel half (Gap 1) is untouched, pre-existing, and scoped as a full-phase-sized undertaking on its own. Left BLOCKED throughout this dispatch per explicit standing user direction ('Leave the Phase 3 sat_timp/truthLemma STOP-gate BLOCKED'). This is the ONLY remaining open item in task 552.

RESOLVED (commits 8b3e8df7, 89a748d7): Branch.lean's ancestorTimes and its identical Bimodal duplicate in SignedFormula.lean collected both directPredecessors and directSuccessors (undirected traversal), spuriously blocking isTemporallyBlocked past depth 1. Fixed by dropping directSuccessors. Re-verified: Gp -> F^k p flips CLOSED for k=1..5; 0 regressions; Bimodal Decidability barrel (792 jobs) green with no proof changes (expandBranchWithFuel_sound's by_cases is opaque to the definition).

RESOLVED (commit 95940a01, after team-lead confirmed Rules.lean is in-scope): allPastPosAt reused the future-only TimeOrdering.ancestorTimes exactly as allFuturePosAt does, checking whether t is in t_anc's forward light-cone -- correct for propagating T(Gphi) forward, wrong for propagating T(Hphi) backward. Fixed by swapping the arguments to check whether t_anc is in t's forward light-cone instead. Re-verified: exactly one row (Hp -> HHp) flips OPEN to CLOSED, zero others change; whole-project build and test both green.
